reason: My guests find me on Google Maps, Glovo and Wolt, and that's where they read the menu, not on a website. I already have a site that nobody really looks at, so paying 25 € a month to move to a new one I'd also have to set up doesn't make sense for me.
objection: It doesn't change the places that matter. If I change the cappuccino price, I still have to fix it on Google, Glovo and Wolt myself, so this is just one more thing to keep up to date, and moving off my current site is a hassle.
would_change_my_mind: If the same WhatsApp message also updated my prices, hours and specials on Google Maps, Glovo and Wolt, without me having to move off my current site.
